name: card-to-crypto
description: Card-to-crypto direct settlement: pay by card, merchant receives crypto on their own wallet.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @cardcrypto/backend && npm run build -w @cardcrypto/sdk
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @cardcrypto/backend && npm run typecheck -w @cardcrypto/sdk
scripts.test: npm run test -w @cardcrypto/backend && npm run test -w @cardcrypto/sdk
